svg.title: Update your notes before saving
svg.desc: The production NoteChangesModal asks about an Idea callout renamed to Insight whose test ID was removed, with illustrative note counts from synthetic data. Both changes are listed above one question, with Leave them as they are chosen on opening; nothing is saved and no note is edited.
